answer: Renew each identity hourly by finding a nonce whose lowercase base32 SHA-256 digest starts prism. Each trial hashes the unique account ID, a fresh hourly salt and the nonce. An echo of one proof cannot ripple into credit for other IDs, since each ID requires separate hashes. Hypothetical example: the non-shareable work averages 33,554,432 hash evaluations per identity per hour; 10 identities cost 335,544,320 evaluations per hour on average.
